# Spec: Recording Bar

> Contract for the on-screen recording indicator. Functional tests verify the
> **Functional** section; the compliance linter + visual checklist verify the
> **Visual** section.

## Overview

- **Source**: `src/widget/recording-bar/` (entry: `index.tsx`)
- **Service**: `Screenshot` (`#/lib/services/capture/screenshot`) — binds
  `recording`, `recording-elapsed`, `audio`
- **Layer/behavior**: single `Astal.Window`, `Layer.OVERLAY`, anchored
  BOTTOM|RIGHT with 12px margin, shown on the currently **focused** Hyprland
  monitor (`monitorIndexFromHyprland`)

## Functional

### States

| # | State | Trigger | Expected behavior |
|---|-------|---------|-------------------|
| F1 | Idle | `Screenshot.recording` false | Window hidden |
| F2 | Recording | `Screenshot.recording` true | Window appears bottom-right of the focused monitor; dot + "REC" label shown |
| F3 | Elapsed time | `recording-elapsed` ticks | Monospace label shows `m:ss`, or `h:mm:ss` when ≥ 1 hour, zero-padded |
| F4 | Audio capture on | `Screenshot.audio` true | Microphone icon (`audio-input-microphone-symbolic`) visible next to the timer |
| F5 | Focused monitor change | Hyprland `focusedMonitor` changes | Bar moves to the newly focused monitor |

### Interactions

| # | Action | Expected behavior |
|---|--------|-------------------|
| I1 | Click stop button | Calls `ss.stopRecording()`; recording ends and window hides |

### Edge cases

| # | Condition | Expected behavior |
|---|-----------|-------------------|
| E1 | Recording starts with audio off | Microphone icon never shown; layout does not leave a gap for it (`visible` binding) |
| E2 | Very long recording | Duration rolls over to `h:mm:ss` without truncation |

## Visual (Adwaita alignment)

### Theme tokens

| Element | Token / style class | Notes |
|---------|--------------------|-------|
| Card container | `card` + `frame` + `background` Adw classes | Inline `padding: 6px 12px` (layout only) |
| Window | inline `background-color: transparent` | Overlay window must be see-through |
| Recording dot | `media-record-symbolic`, 16px | ⚠ Currently hardcoded `#FF0000` — should be `var(--shade-error)` |
| "REC" label | bold, 13px | ⚠ Currently hardcoded `#FF0000` — should be `var(--shade-error)` |
| Elapsed time | monospace, 13px | |
| Stop button | `circular` + `destructive-action` Adw classes, 24px, `media-playback-stop-symbolic` | Adw destructive styling |

### Adwaita checklist

- [ ] Card via Adw `card` class, not custom CSS
- [ ] Error/recording red from `--shade-error`, not literal hex
- [ ] All icons symbolic
- [ ] Readable in light and dark variants (overlay over arbitrary content)

## Test plan

- **Unit**: `formatDuration` (m:ss vs h:mm:ss, zero-padding) — extractable to
  a pure function test in `src/lib/__tests__/`.
- **Compliance linter**: current violations —
  - ERROR `index.tsx:48` theme/hardcoded-color (`#FF0000` dot)
  - ERROR `index.tsx:55` theme/hardcoded-color (`#FF0000` REC label)
  Fix by switching to `var(--shade-error)`.
- **Visual/manual**: screenshot while recording with audio on/off, in light
  and dark variants, on the focused monitor with multiple monitors attached.
